title: agrostis canina var. diffusa
intro: Agrostis canina var. diffusa, commonly known as Wood Horsetail, is a type of flowering plant belonging to the grass family (Poaceae). It is traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating urinary tract problems, kidney stones, and prostate issues due to its diuretic properties. The therapeutic actions of Wood Horsetail include reducing inflammation, promoting wound healing, and supporting the immune system, mainly attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins. The plant's bioactive constituents, particularly silica and glycosides, are also known to have antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
